lines.zh: 我倒挂在枝上，先松开爪子
lines.en: I hang from a branch, then let go
I take off and circle once
My wings flicker in the shade

lines.zh: 我从一棵橡树飞到另一棵
lines.en: I fly from one oak to the next
I skim along the bark
I dangle from a low branch
I weave through the wood
I fly low, almost brushing the grass
I head toward the sound
I skim past the bark
My ears never stop moving

lines.zh: 我朝幽魂橡木林深处飞
lines.en: I fly deeper into the spooky oaks

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦过一片灰白的叶子
lines.en: My wing brushes a pale leaf

lines.zh: 我从树干的一侧翻到另一侧
lines.en: I flip from one side of the trunk to the other
I glide a little way on the wind

lines.zh: 我在低枝和高枝之间来回
lines.en: I go back and forth between low and high branches
I hang upside down with my eyes shut
My wings wrap around me

lines.zh: 树干上有一道我的影子
lines.en: My shadow marks the trunk
I hear insects under the bark

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木林里，我倒挂着。
lines.en: In the spooky oak forest, I hang upside down.
My nose is damp
The trees here are grey and pale
I twitch both ears
I wait for the light to fade more
I lick the tip of my wing
When wind passes, I sway

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，只吐出一口气
lines.en: I open my mouth and only breathe out
I open my eyes and look at you

lines.zh: 你在树下，倒着看有点怪
lines.en: You're below, and you look odd upside down
I let go and drop
You're in my wood

lines.zh: 绕着你飞两圈，翅膀很轻。
lines.en: Two circles around you — my wings are light.
Your torch is too bright
I land on your hat
You raise a hand and I fly off

lines.zh: 我发出一声细细的尖叫
lines.en: I let out a thin shriek
I can't even be bothered to hide
I drop, then lift again
I call, urgently
One of my wings is bent
I hide in the leaves
I hang back on the branch
I fold my wings tighter
My claws feel numb
I press flat to the trunk
I don't dare dive again
I can still hold the bark
You have something sweet
That smell is very strange
I make two turns around it
Is this thing candy
I shouldn't eat it, but I want to
I know the taste of candy
My tongue has gone numb
Something isn't right here
I spit it out
Leave your hand where it is
You hit me and I drop
I catch myself in the air

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦过你的耳朵
lines.en: My wing brushes your ear
I dart past your hand
I hit a trunk and slide down
You step back and I dare land
We both crash into the leaves
My claws snag on a loose thread
I shake myself and fly up
I didn't mean to hit you
Another comes out of the hollow

lines.zh: 我们在枝上倒挂着并排
lines.en: We hang side by side on the branch

lines.zh: 它的翅膀比我的红一点
lines.en: Its wings are redder than mine
We groom each other in turn
It leans its ear to me
We chase each other in the air

lines.zh: 我们倒挂着睡了一会儿
lines.en: We hang and doze together
Its call is lower than mine
This tree fits two
We wait for night together
I take it in my claws
I weigh it; light as a leaf
I carry it up to the branch
It slips through my claws
I hang it on a fork
It's shiny, and I don't like it
I sniff it; it's candy
I take a bite and leave it
I hide it away
I forget where I put it
Something's in the shade
I let go of the branch
My cry sharpened. Like a can opener.
I circle above it
It isn't from this wood

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木林里，我盯上你
lines.en: In the spooky oak forest, I mark you
I dive at its face
This is my tree
Move back a little first
I can tangle its legs
I stay above it
It looks up and I change sides
My claws catch its shoulder
It shakes me off; I fly clear
I hang upside down, right above it
The moment it looks away
It turns and I climb

lines.zh: 这些灰白的树我都认得
lines.en: I know every pale tree here

lines.zh: 我在幽魂橡树间穿来穿去
lines.en: I flit between the spooky oaks

lines.zh: 我贴着树皮绕到它背后
lines.en: I slide around the bark behind it
I bite its ear
My claws rake its face
I hit the back of its head
That wasn't heavy

lines.zh: 它挥手，我翻了个身躲开
lines.en: It swings and I roll clear
I roll over and dive at him again

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扇得它睁不开眼
lines.en: My wings beat until it can't see

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木林里，我绕着树。
lines.en: I circle the spooky oaks.
I land on the tree and try again
It's bleeding a little

lines.zh: 树上有什么松开了爪子
lines.en: Something on the branch lets go
I fly out of the hollow

lines.zh: 一只红色的小影子穿过树影
lines.en: A small red shape crosses the shade

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木林里多了一声尖啸
lines.en: A new shriek in the spooky oaks
I hang from the highest branch
The leaves rustle

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张开，比身体宽
lines.en: My wings open wider than my body
These trees all know me
I make one circuit first
Then I get a clear look at you
The firelight stings and I climb

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔在根上
lines.en: I fall from high onto the roots
Water drags my wings down
The blast slams me against a trunk
An arrow grazes past my ear tip
That force makes my flight unsteady
No food tonight

lines.zh: 雷光照亮整片树林，我无处可藏
lines.en: The flash lights the whole wood; nowhere to hide
No tree here to hang from
